name: Order of the Throne Knight Paladin

resilience.note: Adamantium Armour: 7 AR, Ion Shield: 3* AR

bonuses.name: Pilot
bonuses.text: When crewed by an expert Order of the Throne pilot, the Knight gains +2 dice on all Actions pertinent to combat. Every time the Knight takes damage, the pilot takes 1d3 Shock.

bonuses.name: Juggernaut
bonuses.text: Can make a Stomp attack as a Free Action once per round if all they do is Move.

abilities.name: War Horns
abilities.text: A great echoing roar issues from the machine, forcing everyone who can hear it to make a DN 4 Terror Test.

note: Ion Shield 'AR 3*' has no footnote. Reaper Chainsword prints 'range 5m', Stomp 'Range 3m' and 'Blast 6'; Battle Cannon 'Rapid Fire 2'. Printed in the normal threat format, not the vehicle format. Size prints 'Ggn'.
